title: Not the "stainless steel" I expected
text: Not the "stainless steel" I expected. I purchased this to match the other stainless steel appliances and fixtures in my kitchen, including a new stainless steel Kohler faucet.  This stainless steel I'm referring to has a grayish silver brushed metal look.  But not this kettle.  It is extremely shiny with a color and finish more commonly characterized as polished chrome (which is also how Kohler would describe the color).  The one picture makes it difficult to ascertain this kettle's color and finish.  And the description is of no help; it doesn't describe this product at all.  But now I can say I know something about the Gibson family history.  I submitted a photo to more accurately show the color and finish.  I hope it's helpful.
